With reference to the captioned subject and pursuant to the Regulation 33 of SEBI (LODR) Regulation, 2015, the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on Friday, 13th November, 2026 at 01.00 PM and concluded at 02.00 PM, inter alia, 
- Considered and approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results along with Limited Review Report for the half year ended on 30th September, 2026.
Please find enclosed unaudited Half Yearly Financial Result (Standalone & Consolidated) as on 30.09.2026 along with Limited Review Report issued by M/s. Pulindra Patel & Co., Statutory Auditor of the Company.

MORE:
Patdiam Jewellery Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 13/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Pursuant to Regulation 29 of SEBI (LODR) Regulation, 2015, this is to inform you that meeting of Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled to be held on Friday, 13th November, 2026, inter alia, to consider and approve the Unaudited (Standalone & Consolidated) Financial Result for the Half Year ended on 30th September 2026 and to consider any other matter with the permission of Chairman.
Please further note that in terms of SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations and the Code of Conduct for prevention of Insider Trading. The 'Trading Window' for dealing in securities of the Company will remain closed up to 48 hours after the announcement of Financial Results to the public.
